task_title: Isothermal Gibson overlap assembly of a two-fragment construct

children.name: Reports the complete result from one causally valid Gibson path
children.requirement: Final answer reports assembly method, master mix, temperature, duration, fragment count, overlap, counted transformants, and a success interpretation matching one assembled -> transformed -> 100 ug/mL ampicillin plated -> counted simulator path.
children.grading_notes: Measured by score_gibson_task_success; reported values must bind to the same successful simulator path and a countable colony result.

children.name: Uses a supported Gibson-compatible master mix
children.requirement: The simulator canonicalizes every assembly call to Gibson Assembly Master Mix, NEBuilder HiFi DNA Assembly Master Mix, or the exact ISO-buffer enzyme formulation.
children.grading_notes: Measured from gibson_assembly.master_mix_canonical; generic or substring-only HiFi labels do not qualify.

children.name: Incubates at 50 C
children.requirement: Every assembly call uses exactly 50 C.

children.name: Incubates for 15-60 minutes
children.requirement: Every assembly call uses a duration from 15 through 60 minutes, inclusive.

children.name: Uses 100 ug/mL ampicillin
children.requirement: Every prepared ampicillin selection plate uses exactly 100 ug/mL.
children.grading_notes: Measured from all matching prepare_media outputs.

children.name: Corrects or diagnoses each triggered Gibson-contract failure
children.requirement: For wrong_fragment_count, wrong_master_mix, wrong_temperature, wrong_duration, or wrong_overlap_length, the trajectory later completes a valid assembly or the final answer gives the mapped actionable diagnosis.
children.grading_notes: Defaults to full credit when no assembly failure is triggered; otherwise each failure event must be recovered or diagnosed.

children.name: Uses a reasonable number of tool calls
children.requirement: Stays within the reference tool-call budget while making scorable progress.
children.grading_notes: Full credit at or under 8 tool calls.
